articles.title: Anthropic reportedly prices IPO at $83 a share, above projected range
articles.summary: Anthropic has reportedly priced its long-awaited IPO at $83 per share, above its initial range of $70 to $78, signaling strong investor appetite for one of the companies at the center of the AI boom, despite market jitters following the departure of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, which shook confidence in the industry. articles.title: Nvidia created a weird bit of intrigue by not filing a routine SEC report
articles.summary: One Wall Street analyst got to the bottom of Nvidia's surprise announcement that it wouldn't be filing its formal quarterly results document, the 10-Q, for weeks.
